description: ANSWERS: "what would it cost to screen this list", "how many of my LEIs are covered". PARAM: a list of public LEIs. Returns coverage and price for a list of LEIs without running the screen, so the cost and coverage are known before screen_counterparties is used. Historical observation computed from the public CFPB HMDA 2025 record (actions 1,2,3; loan_type 2). Not a prediction about any individual application. Attribution: FinanceRateCalc, CC BY 4.0.
